svg.title: Production Agentic RAG: end-to-end query journey
svg.desc: Offline ingestion with Airflow, Docling, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch; an online LangGraph agent workflow with a Redis agent cache, local hybrid retrieval, live arXiv fallback, common BGE rerank, grounded generation, structural and semantic validation; Langfuse observability; and the deployment path.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Local-first grounded RAG with an agent cache, live arXiv fallback, answer validation, Langfuse observability, and a Gradio UI
